## </> Pipeline updates {background-color="#1a1a2e"}

- a new pipeline as update to the original LSU pipeline is in development
- it uses the nextflow nf-core/ampliseq pipeline for initial sequence processing
- Tree building and phylogenetic placement are performed by epa-ng and happa
- Original R scripts are used for clade extraction and taxonomy assignment

Source code and documentation: [mdehollander/AMF-LSU-Database-and-Pipeline2 (ampliseq branch)](https://github.com/mdehollander/AMF-LSU-Database-and-Pipeline2/tree/ampliseq/2024_AMFPipeline/2024_AMFPipeline_ASV)

::: {.callout-warning title="Work in progress"}
This pipeline is under active development. Scripts and documentation may change as we finalize the workflow.
:::

- Planned development: These post-ampliseq scripts are currently executed manually in sequence. A standalone Nextflow pipeline is in development that will automate these downstream scripts into a single, reproducible workflow run after ampliseq.
